parallel_experiences.source: David’s 2026-11-04 request, retained in the composed commons projects/jera/sources/2026-11-04-parallel-experiences-dialogue.md
parallel_experiences.northStar: The lexicon being interacted with influences the UI. Private/public are parallel experiences with recognizable shared structure. Fractal architecture is a useful conditional lens.

local_expression: Jera retains page-wide scrolling, destination-specific sticky headers, its shared desktop corner cap, natural finite thread endings and mobile edge-to-edge reading. Body text uses Whyte/sm in both feed and focused threads. Canonical Exact Button/IconButton/Menu families now carry post and composer actions while Jera owns their data and routing. ExperienceModeControl is an app-owned controlled Private/Public radio composition, with canonical Action behavior and minimum 44px targets. One app-local authority exposes current context and ordered, versioned, content-free change events. Mode projects the relevant fixture posts, keys drafts by mode/context and assigns new posts; switching from a reply starts a new post, retaining the editor and normalizing exit/post return to the selected feed. experience.canvas aliases existing bg.base in Public and canonical dao.bg.solid.black in Private (#1A1714 versus #090604 in the dark preview). All authored canvas/mask/modal/surface-button grounds follow that token; the SDK’s fixed host Canvas/background aliases remain unchanged. Explicit comments reserve a future lexicon/context presentation resolver without equating privacy with lexicon identity. Original local comment/send outlines and approved gold primary action remain. Browser evidence does not establish native behavior, access permissions or protocol publication.
limits: Synthetic sample accounts, posts, visibility labels and reply authors
No login, network transport, backend writes or live model replies in this preview
App-local experience context, posts and per-mode/per-parent drafts reset on reload
Public does not publish to ATproto; mode filtering is not backend permission enforcement
Private canvas changes authored surfaces; native-owned host/safe-area paint remains unverified
Geometry findings remain unsuppressed; browser evidence does not establish native keyboard, sheet, assistive-technology or privacy acceptance
